    Methods

    cancelAll

    • cancelAll(): void

      Hard-kill every spawned worker and reject every pending request as 'cancelled'. Unlike destroy, the pool stays usable — the next run call spawns fresh workers on demand.

      mapshaper isn't interruptible mid-command, so this is the only sound way to abandon a job that's already running: terminate the whole worker, lose any other queued jobs as collateral, and start over. A future iteration could add per-request cancellation tokens; v1 keeps this honest by exposing only the all-or-nothing semantics.

      Returns void

      • Defined in src/core/mapshaper-worker-pool.ts:267

    dispatchWithId

    • dispatchWithId(
          id: number,
          cmdOrCommands: string | ParsedCommandWire[],
          packed: any,
          inputFiles?: Record<string, string | Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>>,
          transferList?: Transferable[],
      ): Promise<any>

      Send a message using a previously-reserved id (see reserveId). Returns the result promise. Same failure modes as run: pool destroyed → rejects; worker spawn fails → rejects.

      Parameters

      • id: number

        id accepts number for dispatchWithId. Required; omission is not allowed. Must be assignable to number.

      • cmdOrCommands: string | ParsedCommandWire[]

        cmdOrCommands accepts string | ParsedCommandWire array for dispatchWithId. Required; omission is not allowed. Must be assignable to string | ParsedCommandWire array.

      • packed: any

        packed accepts any for dispatchWithId. Required; omission is not allowed. Must be assignable to any.

      • OptionalinputFiles: Record<string, string | Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>>

        inputFiles accepts Record for dispatchWithId. Optional; omit to leave unset. Must be assignable to Record.

      • OptionaltransferList: Transferable[]

        Optional list of Transferable objects (typed-array .buffers, MessagePorts, …) handed to postMessage. When supplied, ownership moves to the worker — saves a structured-clone copy and roughly halves the main-thread memory peak around a pack/unpack round-trip.

        Callers that share the buffers with main-thread code must NOT pass them via this list (transfer is destructive on the source realm).

      Returns Promise<any>

    reserveId

    • reserveId(): number

      Reserve a correlation id without sending anything. Call dispatchWithId with the same id later to actually post the message. Useful when the caller wants to fire a "started" event with a stable id BEFORE doing expensive sync work (e.g. dataset packing) that delays the postMessage.

      Returns number

    runWithId

    • runWithId(
          cmdOrCommands: string | ParsedCommandWire[],
          packed: any,
          inputFiles?: Record<string, string | Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>>,
      ): { id: number; promise: Promise<any> }

      Same as run, but also surfaces the correlation id synchronously so the caller can fire an event referencing the id BEFORE the promise resolves. Used by Emap's workerjobstart / workerjobend events.

      Even on an immediately-rejecting path (destroyed pool, or environments lacking a Worker constructor), the returned id is still drawn from the same monotonic counter so it never collides with live ids — UI code can correlate a workerjobstart with a synchronously-rejecting workerjobend without aliasing.

      Parameters

      • cmdOrCommands: string | ParsedCommandWire[]
